post_interview_reconciliation.original_question: May an external provider receive product material for extraction or reflection?
post_interview_reconciliation.reconciliation: Processing is local-first. No external provider is approved for the first release. The model-a external reflection route is disabled; a refusal, outage, revoked consent, expired capability, unknown classification, or disabled route fails closed for that route and must not select another provider, broaden a data class, or substitute a local result. A future GO requires route-specific provider approval, DPA/egress assessment, owner consent and disclosure, capability boundary, retention and deletion-residual terms, and class-filtering fixtures.

reason: No provider approval, DPA/egress assessment, consent fixture, deletion evidence, or provider terms exist for the model-a route. ADR-0028 adopts local-first processing and no-provider-fallback for the first release, so the route is disabled by explicit decision rather than left unresolved.
